| GBP161.50pppw | 1 Room in STUDENT HOUSE SHARE | Clifton, BS8 | Available: 01/08/2026 |

This well-presented double bedroom is available within a spacious and characterful professional house share on the sought-after Pembroke Road, Clifton. Fully furnished and offering comfortable accommodation in one of Bristol's most desirable locations, this room is ideal for professionals seeking convenience and a welcoming home.

The bedroom is furnished with a double bed, wardrobe, chest of drawers, bedside cabinet, and built-in desk with chair, providing a practical space for both working and relaxing. A large rear-facing window overlooking greenery allows plenty of natural light, while attractive period features add character to the room.

The property benefits from a large communal kitchen and dining area, fully equipped with a gas hob, oven, extractor fan, fridge freezer, washing machine, tumble dryer, and ample worktop space, creating an ideal environment for cooking and socialising.

Residents also have access to a comfortable communal lounge, featuring high ceilings, original cornicing, a feature fireplace, and large windows, providing a bright and relaxing shared living space.

The house offers multiple bathroom facilities, including both a bath with overhead shower and a separate shower room, making it well suited to shared living.

Located on the prestigious Pembroke Road, the property is within easy walking distance of Whiteladies Road, Clifton Village, The Triangle, and the University of Bristol. Excellent transport links, independent caf s, shops, restaurants, and The Downs are all close by, making this an exceptional location for professionals or postgraduate students.

A fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious room in one of Bristol's most desirable locations - contact us today to arrange your viewing. Bills not included.
